value.rationale: A natural, heterogeneous infinite class of block graphs has an exact full-time transport classification and a sharp operator norm controlled by the smallest clique, despite additional variable spectral modes. At fixed vertex count, partitions changing many internal edges leave the entire Lipschitz norm curve unchanged if the minimum blade stays the same; when the minimum grows the precise improvement is 2(s−1)(e^{−t}−e^{−(k+1)t})/k. This finite-graph semigroup invariant is mathematically motivated, nontrivial, and not a recomputation of the previously known first-variation threshold.
